caseNameFull: John Barton Payne, as Agent, etc. v. Industrial Accident Commission of the State of California

opinions.text: January 17,1921. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of the State of California denied. Mr. Henley C. Booth and Mr. William F. Herrin for petitioner. Mr. Neal Power, and Mr. Warren H. Pillsbury for respondents.
